goal: Run the three non-Deployment workload controllers against real MFS port data: a per-node DaemonSet agent, an Indexed Job that splits a work queue across parallel Pods, and a CronJob on a schedule - then fail a Job past its backoffLimit and read the reason.
produces: A berth-agent DaemonSet reporting DESIRED=CURRENT=1 on the single-node kind cluster, reading berth-readings.csv
A completed Indexed Job (completions 6, parallelism 2) whose six Pods each processed a distinct queue line
A tariff-sync CronJob with concurrencyPolicy Forbid and a retained Job history
concepts: DaemonSet replica count is derived from the node set, never from a replicas field
completions vs parallelism vs backoffLimit, and Indexed completion mode with JOB_COMPLETION_INDEX
CronJob schedule, timeZone, concurrencyPolicy and the successful/failed Job history limits
A Job that exhausts backoffLimit is marked Failed with reason BackoffLimitExceeded and stops retrying
